name: positioning-doc
description: Write a product positioning document. Use when the user says "write a positioning doc", "positioning statement", "how should we position this product", "positioning for [product]", "we need to differentiate from competitors", "product positioning and messaging", "positioning workshop", "help me define our position in the market", or wants to establish how a product should be perceived relative to competitors. For customer-facing message wording, see messaging-framework. For the competitive research behind it, see competitor-analyst. For storing it in the knowledge base, see brand-context.
